description: This file implements the EncryptedSerializable class which handles encryption, decryption, and serialization of data using TPM (Trusted Platform Module) resources. It includes methods for creating and loading TPM keys, serializing/deserializing encrypted data, and managing TPM objects within a secure environment.

classes.name: EncryptedSerializable
classes.description: A class that manages encrypted serialization of data using TPM keys, including creation, loading, serialization, and deserialization of encrypted data.

methods.name: EncryptedSerializable::SerializedSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the serialized encrypted data, including TPM key info, IV, wrapped data, and encrypted payload.

methods.name: EncryptedSerializable::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the wrapped data into a buffer, encrypting it with a TPM key and appending necessary metadata.

methods.name: EncryptedSerializable::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer, decrypts it using TPM, and reconstructs the wrapped object.
